assignment.goal: Implement the additive Reviews preview vertical slice and bind all nine acceptance scenarios, using a new neutral Validation provider and the real Catalog Core resolver through an authorized contract.
assignment.approach: Add preview to the existing router as a mutation taking only a required chain parsed by revisionChainSchema. Delegate judgment to a new provider owned and exposed by Validation; share existing finding rules without changing validateRevisionChain's interpretation of report facts. Keep names and internal rule-sharing design flexible, including the optional report-shaped approach. The provider must import the real Catalog Core resolver, resolve only supplied-chain references, never read/write records, retain ordering and repeated findings, and return only status and findings through tRPC. The resolver is currently private: when implementing the actual provider call, submit capability-needed describing the missing exposure/relay contract and calling code; do not duplicate resolution, import illegally, or edit external owners. After handback, verify actual imports and all relays. Add direct provider tests retaining the chain array and revision objects to prove nonmutation. Exercise intact, empty, missing, duplicate and repeated-reference results through createTestSystem's assembled typed client with real providers; send deliberately untyped/miscast absent and malformed inputs and assert BAD_REQUEST with no judgment. Add exact client input/output type assertions, preserving run type tests. Bind sc-001 through sc-009 in local tests/steps without editing feature files; avoid duplicate global steps and keep scenario state isolated despite the globally registered World/hooks. Preserve tRPC run, MCP tools, session behavior, observations and all configured checks. Update Reviews and Validation declarations, source descriptions and READMEs for the provider dependency. Coordinate, but do not implement, the separate Catalog Core snapshot requirement outside this scope.
